closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, protein, and easy protein delivery for normal diets, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, saturated fat, and low vitamin B12. It is good for practical meals, immune support, and blood and oxygen support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
